fonts_and_typography.sans_stack: 'Inter', 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI Variable Display', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif
fonts_and_typography.mono_stack: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Cascadia Code', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
fonts_and_typography.tabular_nums: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on badges, counters, timers, and budget pills

smooth_micro_animations_and_tactile_butt.transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 180ms ease, background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, opacity 160ms ease

stop_and_resume_ux.stop_button: Expressive high-contrast red stop state with subtle @keyframes stop-pulse / cc-stop-pulse glow (disabled when STOP is already active or under prefers-reduced-motion)
stop_and_resume_ux.resume_button: Prominent green-accented «Продолжить» (.stop-resume with --ok/--ok-ink >= 4.5:1 WCAG contrast, and #computer-resume) action button

approval_and_rollback_ux.approval_meta: Structured .approval-meta pills showing approval_kind, model, task #id, status, and cost ($0.00 / N/A) with <= 320px narrow-viewport overflow protection
approval_and_rollback_ux.rollback_hint: Explicit .rollback-hint instructions rendered in both Bossman Mobile and Command Center approval cards

honest_status_and_budget_badges.na_badges: Distinct .is-na / .na-badge / .badge-na styling when metrics or session cost are unconnected (spent_usd: null, connected: false, or fetch error -> N/A instead of misleading $0.00)
